fields.Name: T77 - Email Template View
fields.Description: Verifies an Email Template record form opens with its fields.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Email Templates' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, click a template row, then click 'Open Full Record'. Verify the Email Template record form opened showing its fields (e.g. Name, Subject, Category). The body/content may live in a SEPARATE section lower on the form (scroll/expand if present), but verifying the template record form opened with its detail fields (including Subject) is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: An Email Template record form is displayed
Template fields including Subject are shown (the body/content may be in a separate section)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
